description: This file provides a lightweight HTTP client wrapper for making API requests in a React-based frontend project. It handles URL construction, request timeouts, JSON serialization/deserialization, and error handling, serving as a core utility for network communication with the backend.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL from a relative path using the environment's API base URL.

methods.name: parseResponse(resp)
methods.description: Processes the fetch response, attempting JSON parsing and falling back to text message.

methods.name: httpRequest(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, timeoutMs = 12000, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with support for timeout, JSON handling, and error normalization.

methods.name: httpGet(path, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request and returns parsed response data.

methods.name: httpPost(path, body, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON body and returns parsed response data.

methods.name: httpUpload(path, formData, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a multipart/form-data upload with FormData.

methods.name: isMockMode()
methods.description: Checks whether the application is running in mock mode (no API base configured).

ctags.name: httpGet
ctags.pattern: /^export async function httpGet(path, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: httpPost
ctags.pattern: /^export async function httpPost(path, body, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: httpRequest
ctags.pattern: /^export async function httpRequest(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, timeoutMs = 12000,/

ctags.name: httpUpload
ctags.pattern: /^export async function httpUpload(path, formData, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: method
ctags.pattern: /^  const opts = { method, headers: { ...headers }, signal: controller.signal };$/

fields.name: const opts = { method, headers: { ...headers }, signal: controller.signal };
